title: Identification and Validation of Autophagy- and Inflammatory-Related Genes in Childhood Asthma via Integrated Bioinformatics and Clinical Samples.
authors: Huang, Mingjing; Wu, Jihua; Xu, Daliang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过整合生物信息学和机器学习识别儿童哮喘自噬-炎症相关诊断基因，虽涉及转录因子网络构建但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Childhood asthma (CA) is a prevalent chronic airway disease, yet the roles of autophagy and inflammation in its pathogenesis remain poorly understood. Transcriptomic datasets were retrieved from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO). Inflammation- and autophagy-related genes were identified using weighted gene co-expression network analysis and consensus clustering and intersected with differentially expressed genes (DEGs) to identify candidate genes. Subsequently, 101 machine learning algorithm combinations were evaluated to select key genes for diagnostic model construction. Functional characterization involved immune infiltration analysis, gene set enrichment analysis, and transcription factor network construction. Mendelian randomization (MR) was used to assess potential causal relationships between key genes and CA, and gene expression was validated by quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) in clinical blood samples. The analysis identified 39 candidate genes associated with autophagy and inflammation. Machine learning identified 10 key genes, and the resulting diagnostic model achieved areas under the curve of 0.768, 0.751, and 0.710 in the training, test, and validation sets, respectively. Pathway and immune infiltration analyses revealed enrichment in signaling, metabolic, and immune-regulatory functions and significant correlations with immune cell infiltration. MR analysis suggested a potential causal association between genetically predicted STYXL1 expression and CA risk. qPCR analysis in five CA patients and five healthy controls showed expression patterns consistent with the transcriptomic findings. However, the small clinical validation cohort limits the generalizability of these results. This study identifies a 10-gene peripheral blood diagnostic signature associated with CA and highlights STYXL1 as a potential causal risk gene supported by genetic evidence. Larger clinical cohorts and functional studies are required to validate these findings.
abstract_zh: 儿童哮喘（CA）是一种常见的慢性气道疾病，然而自噬和炎症在其发病机制中的作用仍知之甚少。从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）中获取转录组数据集。利用加权基因共表达网络分析和共识聚类识别炎症及自噬相关基因，并与差异表达基因（DEGs）取交集以确定候选基因。随后，评估了101种机器学习算法组合，以选择关键基因用于诊断模型构建。功能表征涉及免疫浸润分析、基因集富集分析和转录因子网络构建。采用孟德尔随机化（MR）评估关键基因与CA之间的潜在因果关系，并通过定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）在临床血液样本中验证基因表达。分析识别出39个与自噬和炎症相关的候选基因。机器学习确定了10个关键基因，所得诊断模型在训练集、测试集和验证集中的曲线下面积分别为0.768、0.751和0.710。通路和免疫浸润分析揭示了信号传导、代谢和免疫调节功能的富集，以及与免疫细胞浸润的显著相关性。MR分析提示，基因预测的STYXL1表达与CA风险之间存在潜在因果关联。对5名CA患者和5名健康对照者的qPCR分析显示，表达模式与转录组结果一致。然而，较小的临床验证队列限制了这些结果的普适性。本研究确定了与CA相关的10基因外周血诊断特征，并强调STYXL1为具有遗传证据支持的潜在因果风险基因。需要更大的临床队列和功能研究来验证这些发现。
